//: A Stop hook that runs the real gate. The recurring failure this repo has seen is a change reported as done before typecheck, tests or a build were run — twice in one session that shipped a bug to a live storefront. CI cannot catch it: jobs in this org execute zero steps (unpaid billing), so a red check means nothing and a green one is unavailable. This makes the gate automatic rather than remembered. It is fast: typecheck ~5s, 66 tests <1s.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { pnpm exec tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -15; pnpm exec vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E 'Test Files|Tests '; } || true
